summary: Iter7 — Tested newly-implemented Customer Cancel UI on /orders + regression-tested PII redaction & seller/kitchen views. Cancel UI renders perfectly (data-testids confirmed: cancel-marketplace-order-{id}, cancel-restaurant-order-{id}, cancel-order-modal, cancel-reason-input, confirm-cancel-order-btn, keep-order-btn, close-cancel-modal). However the END-TO-END CANCEL FLOW IS BROKEN due to TWO critical bugs: (1) Every cancel endpoint (customer+seller+admin) returns HTTP 422 'missing body' — FastAPI does not auto-detect the CancelBody Pydantic class because it is declared inside the register_cod_routes() closure in /app/backend/cod.py:1398; (2) Orders.jsx & SellerWalletTab.jsx pass `err.response?.data?.detail` (which is a FastAPI ValidationError list-of-objects) straight into toast.error/JSX, causing 'Objects are not valid as a React child' → ErrorBoundary swallows the entire /orders page. Setup: created customer testcust_1778675277@cancel.com (TestPass123!) via /api/admin/users, reset seller1_1778671094@test.com to SellerPass123!, placed 1 restaurant order (91dcbec5-0266-42bc-9d5b-b93c744bbf85) + 1 marketplace order (c5d96620-6212-464a-9873-402789461c72). PII regression: ✅ seller Wallet→Active Orders shows ONLY customer name 'Cancel Customer' — phone +211900111222 and 'Test Addr 1' address are NOT in the HTML. Kitchen dashboard could not fully verify because of bug #3 below.

critical.issue: Returns 422 {detail:[{type:missing, loc:[query,body], msg:Field required}]} for ALL bodies. FastAPI is treating `body: CancelBody` as a query param — root cause: `class CancelBody(BaseModel)` is defined inside the closure `register_cod_routes()` (cod.py:1398). Fix: either move CancelBody to module level, or annotate parameter `body: CancelBody = Body(...)`.
Same 422 'missing body' — same root cause (closure-scoped Pydantic class).

critical_code_review_comments: Closure-scoped Pydantic models are a recurring footgun with FastAPI; consider a module-level `class CancelBody(BaseModel): reason: Optional[str] = ''` and remove the nested definition.

Frontend uniformly relies on `err.response?.data?.detail` for toast messages — this will break for ANY 422 (Pydantic returns a list). Centralize error extraction in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js with a helper like `extractErrorMessage(err)` and reuse everywhere.

Iter6 report claimed seller cancel worked — its tests pass because they hit an internal helper, not the HTTP route via httpx with the full FastAPI dependency stack. Add a real HTTP smoke test for each cancel endpoint in /app/backend/tests/.

rca of the issue: BUG #1 (backend) — Reproduction: `curl -X POST https://payout-otp.preview.emergentagent.com/api/customer/restaurant-orders/{order_id}/cancel -H 'Authorization: Bearer <customer-token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"reason":"x"}'` returns 422 {detail:[{type:missing, loc:[query,body], msg:'Field required'}]}. RCA: `class CancelBody(BaseModel): reason: Optional[str] = ''` is declared inside the closure `register_cod_routes()` in /app/backend/cod.py at line 1398. FastAPI's dependency analyser sometimes fails to identify a closure-local BaseModel subclass as a request body and falls back to treating the param as a query field. Mitigation: move CancelBody to module level (top of cod.py), OR annotate each endpoint param as `body: CancelBody = Body(...)`. BUG #2 (frontend) — Reproduction: open /orders as the customer above, click any cancel button, confirm. RCA: Orders.jsx line 56 `toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to cancel order')` — for a 422 the detail is List[Dict], sonner accepts JSX/string and React tries to render an Object child → 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. ErrorBoundary catches it, page becomes blank 'Something went wrong'. Mitigation: coerce non-string detail (`Array.isArray(d) ? d.map(e=>e.msg).join(', ') : typeof d === 'string' ? d : JSON.stringify(d)`). BUG #3 (kitchen) — Toast 'Restaurant not found' on a valid /kitchen/{id} for the owning seller; restaurant-open-toggle absent. Likely a 404 from whichever endpoint KitchenDashboard.jsx fetches on mount — needs main agent to grep KitchenDashboard.jsx for the GET call and inspect backend route auth.
